description: Said eleven pound six, and would not divide it into a share on the stair.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Heard the quiet hold for a minute under the jig, and would not invent the Rose's takings.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Set down a heavy box and a quiet yard, and left.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: The grain held, and he did not want the doublet discussed.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Kept the garden's laugh inside the garden.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Had danced the jig like a man owed money, and said so without pricing it.
name: Will Kemp

description: Looked from the door, and did not step into the sweep.
name: William Shakespeare
